meta.title: Sustainability Events
meta.description: The J.R.D. Tata Ethics Oration, held at XLRI since 1991, and the Dr. Verghese Kurien Memorial Oration on Sustainable Development — every speaker and their talk.

series.name: J.R.D. Tata Ethics Oration
series.summary: Delivered at XLRI since 1991, when J.R.D. Tata gave the first oration.

orations.title: Transforming Capitalism to Make the World Better for Everyone
orations.speaker: Mr. Arun Maira
orations.bio: Mr. Arun Maira, former member of India’s Planning Commission and ex-Chairman of BCG India, is a leading thinker on leadership and systems transformation. He is the author of books on ethics, institutional reform, and capitalism, including The Learning Factory and Shaping the Future.

orations.speaker: Mr. Bhaskar Bhat
orations.bio: Mr. Bhaskar Bhat, former Managing Director of Titan Company Limited, led the company’s diversification and growth to a $13 billion market cap. A senior Tata Group executive, he serves on multiple boards and has received Distinguished Alumnus Awards from IIT Madras and IIM Ahmedabad.

orations.title: Business Ethics and Stakeholder Capitalism
orations.speaker: Dr. Edward Freeman
orations.bio: Dr. R. Edward Freeman is University Professor at the University of Virginia Darden School of Business and a pioneer of stakeholder theory. He is best known for his book Strategic Management: A Stakeholder Approach and has authored over 100 volumes and 200 articles in business ethics and strategy.

orations.title: China: The Emerging Superpower: The Ethical Underpinnings
orations.speaker: Dr. Stephen Rothlin
orations.bio: Dr. Stephen Rothlin, director of the Macau Ricci Institute and founder of Rothlin International Management Consulting Ltd., holds a PhD in moral theology. Fluent in six languages, he is an expert in international business ethics focused on China and corporate responsibility.

orations.title: Ethics in Action: Corporate Social Responsibility in the 21st Century
orations.speaker: Dr. Jennifer J. Griffin
orations.bio: Dr. Jennifer J. Griffin, professor of business ethics at Loyola University Chicago, is a global expert on CSR and strategic corporate impact and an award-winning academic and author.

orations.title: My Experiences with JRD and His Principles
orations.speaker: J.J. Irani
orations.bio: Dr. J.J. Irani, former Managing Director of Tata Steel, played a key role in modernizing India’s steel industry and chaired the committee advising on India’s Companies Act.

orations.title: The Place of International Law in Seeking Sustainable Development for India: Some Ethical Reflections
orations.speaker: Fr. Frank Brennan, SJ
orations.bio: Fr. Dr. Frank Brennan, SJ, Australian Jesuit and law professor, is a noted advocate for Indigenous rights, social justice, and ethical leadership in public life.

orations.title: Changing Role of Media in Today’s India
orations.speaker: Shekhar Gupta
orations.bio: Shekhar Gupta, veteran journalist and founder of Mediascape, is known for his fearless reporting and editorial leadership, with landmark coverage of key political and global events.

orations.title: Building Trust
orations.speaker: D. Shivakumar
orations.bio: D. Shivakumar, former CEO of PepsiCo India and Nokia India, is a business leader and marketer known for growing global brands and mentoring young professionals.

orations.title: Ethical Challenges for India Today
orations.speaker: Pallam Raju Mallipudi
orations.bio: Dr. Pallam Raju Mallipudi, former HRD Minister of India, has advanced education reform, skill development, and innovation and represented India at major international forums.

orations.title: Heroic Leaders: Who They Are and How They Live
orations.speaker: Chris Lowney
orations.bio: Dr. Chris Lowney, former JP Morgan Managing Director and leadership author, advocates Jesuit-based leadership and founded initiatives supporting education in refugee communities.

orations.title: Values and Ethics in a Volatile World
orations.speaker: Laxman Narasimhan
orations.bio: Laxman Narasimhan, former CEO of PepsiCo Latin America and McKinsey partner, is known for his leadership in global consumer markets and contributions to public policy and education.

orations.title: Business Ethics
orations.speaker: Tarun Das
orations.bio: Tarun Das, former Director General of CII, shaped India’s industrial policy and international trade relations. He earned national and international honors including the Padma Bhushan and an honorary CBE.

orations.title: Atomic Energy in India – Emerging Scenario
orations.speaker: Anil Kakodkar
orations.bio: Dr. Anil Kakodkar, former Chairman of India’s Atomic Energy Commission, was instrumental in developing indigenous nuclear technology and played a key role in India’s nuclear tests and energy programs.

orations.title: 21st Century Business Paradigm
orations.speaker: Steven J. Snyder
orations.bio: Steven J. Snyder, founder of Snyder Leadership Group and former Microsoft executive, co-developed collaborative filtering technology and pioneered online personalization as co-founder of Net Perceptions.

orations.title: All about Integrity, Values and Morals
orations.speaker: Subroto Bagchi
orations.bio: Subroto Bagchi, co-founder of Mindtree, is a respected entrepreneur and author, known for his work in leadership development and values-driven business practices within India’s IT sector.

orations.title: Corporate Ethics and the Bottom Line: Why Fighting Corruption Matters for Business
orations.speaker: Peter Eigen
orations.bio: Dr. Peter Eigen, founder of Transparency International, is a relentless global advocate against corruption. He has worked with the World Bank and led initiatives like the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.

orations.title: Tourism in Developing Countries: Neocolonialism or Nation Builder
orations.speaker: Fr. James J. Spillane, SJ
orations.bio: Fr. Dr. James J. Spillane, SJ, American Jesuit priest and academic, has worked extensively in Indonesia on international economics and the ethical dimensions of tourism.

orations.title: Corporate Governance and the Church’s Contribution
orations.speaker: Telesphore P. Cardinal Toppo
orations.bio: Telesphore P. Cardinal Toppo, the first Adivasi Indian Cardinal and Archbishop of Ranchi, was a key church leader and advocate of social work and education.

orations.title: Ethics and Media
orations.speaker: Mark Tully
orations.bio: Sir Mark Tully, veteran BBC journalist, is celebrated for his profound reporting on South Asia and for authoring numerous books on India and religion.

orations.title: The Past and Future of the Environmental Movement: Its Social and Ethical Perspectives
orations.speaker: Ramachandra Guha
orations.bio: Dr. Ramachandra Guha, renowned historian and environmental thinker, has authored widely on India’s ecological and social history.

orations.title: Globalization and Corporate Ethics
orations.speaker: Fr. Robert F. Drinan, SJ
orations.bio: Dr. Robert F. Drinan, SJ, was a Jesuit priest, lawyer, U.S. Congressman, and Georgetown law professor known for his work on legal ethics and international human rights.

orations.title: Role of Business in Ecological Security: An Ethical Perspective
orations.speaker: Amrita Patel
orations.bio: Dr. Amrita Patel, former Chairman of the National Dairy Development Board, played a transformative role in Operation Flood and has been a dedicated environmentalist and development activist.

orations.title: Business Ethics: The Bitter–Sweet Ambrosia
orations.speaker: Suresh Krishna
orations.bio: Suresh Krishna, Chairman and Managing Director of Sundram Fasteners Ltd., is a pioneering industrialist known for building a global manufacturing business from a modest start.

orations.title: Ethics in Media
orations.speaker: Chris Frost
orations.bio: Prof. Chris Frost, former Head of Journalism at Liverpool John Moores University, is a media ethics expert and long-time member of the NUJ Ethics Council and UK Press Council.

orations.title: Business Ethics: Commandments of Truth, Sacrifice, Integrity and Trusteeship
orations.speaker: Tarjani Vakil
orations.bio: Tarjani Vakil, the first Indian woman to head a financial institution, revolutionized ethical standards in banking and held leadership roles across major development banks.

orations.title: Development and Ethics: A Jesuit Perspective
orations.speaker: Fr. Peter-Hans Kolvenbach, SJ
orations.bio: Fr. Peter-Hans Kolvenbach, SJ, 29th Superior General of the Jesuits, was a theologian and linguist who led the Society of Jesus for over two decades.

orations.title: An Interpretation of Conscience in Business Life
orations.speaker: Dr. Kenneth E. Goodpaster
orations.bio: Dr. Kenneth E. Goodpaster, business ethics professor at Harvard and the University of St. Thomas, contributed widely to ethical reasoning and corporate responsibility.

orations.title: Business Ethics – Some Reflections
orations.speaker: Justice Bakhtavar Lentin
orations.bio: Justice Bakhtavar Lentin, distinguished Bombay High Court judge, was renowned for exposing corruption in public health administration through landmark judicial inquiries.

orations.title: Establishing and Maintaining an Ethical Business Climate
orations.speaker: Joseph M. Sciortino
orations.bio: Joseph M. Sciortino, former CEO of Sysco Food Services, was a respected advocate for business ethics and an active philanthropist devoted to faith and community service.

orations.title: Ethics and Business Success
orations.speaker: J.R.D. Tata
orations.bio: J.R.D. Tata, Chairman Emeritus of Tata Sons Ltd., was a visionary industrialist who led the Tata Group for 50 years, championing ethical business practices and inclusive nation-building.

series.name: Dr. Verghese Kurien Memorial Oration on Sustainable Development

orations.title: The AMUL Model: Transforming Lives of Millions
orations.speaker: Jayen Mehta
orations.bio: Jayen Mehta is Managing Director of Amul, Gujarat Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation Ltd (GCMMF), and a leader in cooperative-based rural development and dairy transformation.

orations.title: Empowering the Next Generation: Taking Action on Climate Change & Sustainability
orations.speaker: Vaishali Nigam Sinha
orations.bio: Vaishali Nigam Sinha is Chief Sustainability Officer at ReNew Power and Chair of the ReNew Foundation, advocating climate action and women’s leadership.

orations.title: India’s SDG Localization Model
orations.speaker: Suman Bery
orations.bio: Suman Bery is Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog and former Chief Economist at Royal Dutch Shell, with a strong background in policy research and sustainable development.

orations.title: Unpacking ESG – Putting ‘S’ at the Centre
orations.speaker: Shankar Venkateswaran
orations.bio: Shankar Venkateswaran, founding head of the Tata Sustainability Group, is a sustainability advisor and co-founder of ECube Investment Advisors.

orations.title: Eco-Swaraj: Recovery towards Justice & Sustainability
orations.speaker: Ashish Kothari
orations.bio: Ashish Kothari, co-founder of Kalpavriksh, is a prominent environmentalist and advisor on conservation and sustainability initiatives.

orations.title: Oneness vs. The 1%: Ecological Responses to the Threat for Planet and Humanity
orations.speaker: Vandana Shiva
orations.bio: Vandana Shiva, environmental activist and founder of Navdanya, is internationally recognized for advocating biodiversity and ecological sustainability.

orations.title: Economic Growth and Social Development
orations.speaker: Jean Drèze
orations.bio: Jean Drèze, development economist, is noted for his work on public policy and social rights in India.

orations.title: The Machine Revolution: Fulfilling the Aspirations of Rural India
orations.speaker: Ashok Khosla
orations.bio: Ashok Khosla is Chairman of Development Alternatives Group and President of the Club of Rome, with extensive experience in environmental and sustainable development.

orations.title: Living with Anubandh: A Way to Sustainability
orations.speaker: Ela Bhatt
orations.bio: Ela Bhatt, Gandhian and founder of SEWA, served as its general secretary and later as chancellor of Gujarat Vidyapith.

orations.title: The 21st Century Gandhian Model to Sustainability
orations.speaker: Bunker Roy
orations.bio: Sanjit “Bunker” Roy, founder of Barefoot College, is a social activist recognized for empowering rural communities through education.

orations.title: Unequal is Unsustainable
orations.speaker: P. Sainath
orations.bio: P. Sainath, Founder Editor of the People’s Archive of Rural India (PARI), is an acclaimed rural journalist and Ramon Magsaysay Awardee.
